publisher: Census of India (Office of the Registrar General); reprint volume with foreword by A. Mitra, 1960
title: Census of India: Actuarial Reports for the Census 1881, 1891, 1901, 1911, 1921, 1931 & 1951
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: Census actuaries' life tables derived from successive census age distributions, with assumed or registration-based mortality at infant and child ages.
coverage: Combined British Indian provinces investigated at each census (area varies by census); 1941-50 table for post-partition India.
limitations: Scanned; values read visually from page images. Pre-1931 tables cover selected provinces only; infant/child mortality largely assumed; the 1921 report gives no rates under age 5; no 1941 age tabulation. Male and female only (persons printed only for 1881).

publisher: Office of the Registrar General, India
title: Census of India 1971, Series 1 India, Paper 1 of 1977: Life Tables
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: Life tables for 1961-70 from 1961 and 1971 census age data, compared with 1951-60 tables.
limitations: Scanned; values read from page image. q0 based on SRS values/assumptions. Its Appendix C Table 5 mixes Kingsley Davis estimates (1921, 1941) with actuarial reports and was not used.

publisher: Office of the Registrar General, India
title: Census of India 1971, Census Centenary Monograph No. 9: Extracts from the All India Census Reports on Literacy (D. Natarajan)
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: ORGI statement of literates per 1,000 population at each census 1881-1971, plus extracts of the census reports.
limitations: Mixed definitions: 1881-1891 include 'learning'; the 1931 figure matches the 1931 report's age 5+ ratio; 1941 provisional and possibly includes partial literacy. Scanned.

publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (Central Statistics Office)
title: Women and Men in India 2016, Chapter 3: Literacy and Education
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: Reproduces Census of India (ORGI) literacy rates 1951-2011.
limitations: Official secondary reproduction; 1951 (18.32) and 1961 (28.31) differ by 0.01 from values commonly quoted (18.33, 28.30). Age base 5+ to 1971, 7+ from 1981; coverage exclusions in 1981, 1991, 2001.

publisher: Census of India (Census Commissioner for India)
title: Census of India 1941, Paper No. 3 (1949): Probable Effect of Decrease in Infantile Mortality on Future Population (S. Swaroop)
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: Annual infant mortality rates per 1,000 live births from registration areas of former British Indian provinces now in the Union of India, averaged to represent the Union of India, 1920-1946.
limitations: Based on incomplete civil registration; 1920 value is unclear in the scan (195 or 196) and was omitted; not comparable with SRS.
